title: ReBacked
description: Fancy Minecraft is back! Transforms your Minecraft by adding more new contents, performance, more elements, more actions.
body:
# **🥳Welcome🥳**

![Tile](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a1de181c9f60b1d237c190038ddf7179993bb85.png)

**Fancy Minecraft is back! This modpack transforms Minecraft into the most powerful, most beautiful graphic, most useuful elememts, great contents. This modpack also makes the game much easier for beginners, but at least it stills add some hard challenge for people who is interested this modpack.**
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
# **🌟Why you should try this modpack🌟**

Because this modpack is attempting to optimize your game in the most modern way. If you're a beginners of Minecraft, this modpack makes the game much easier, but this modpack also adds a lot of challenges, in both Overworld and The End, so you can explore them without go far away.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
**🗃️Which mod does this modpack include?🗃️**

This modpack includes **many of mods**, **more than 300 mods total!** Include **optimization mods, QOL (Quality-of-Life mods), PVP mods, world generation mods, adventure mods**,...


<details>
<summary>🗃️Some mods included in this modpack (grouped)</summary>

a. **⚡Optimization mods:**

- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Lithium
- ImmediatelyFast
- Cull Leaves

...

b. **🪟QOF mods:**

- Continuity
- Instant Feedback
- AmbientSounds
- AppleSkin
- Accurate Block Placement Reborn

c. **⚔️PVP mods: (just one :))**

- Do a Barrel Roll

d. **🏝️World Generation mods:**

- Trek
- Revamped Shipwerks
- Nullscape
- Structory
- Towns and Towers

...

e. **📚Library mods:**

- JamLib
- Resurceful Lib
- Fabric API
- CreativeCore
- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)

...

</details>

All mods can be found at the [version page](https://modrinth.com/modpack/rebacked/version/1.0.0), in the Dependencies list.

**All mods and resource packs that can be distributed through Modrinth are listed as Dependencies, and they will be downloaded automatically when you install the modpack.**
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
# **🧐Frequently Asked Questions🧐**

Q. Why don't you update this modpack for newer minecraft versions? Why don't you backport this modpack for older Minecraft versions or port for other mod loaders?

A. Because this modpack is **one-person made**, and it also contains **more than 300 mods, and some mods might not be up-to-date probably**, example MordernFix, but luckily, **there's a mod named ModernFix-mVUS solved this**.
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Q. Can I fork this modpack for older Minecraft versions/newer Minecraft versions/snapshots/other mod loaders?

A. Yes, you **can fork this modpack** for older Minecraft versions/newer Minecraft versions/snapshots/other mod loaders, **without asking me**, but remember to **leave a credit**.
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Q. Which shaders is best for this modpack?

A. If you have a strong PC: [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/project/HVnmMxH1).

If you have a VERY STRONG PC: [Photon Shaders](https://modrinth.com/project/lLqFfGNs).

If you have a weak PC (low-end PC/Laptop): [MakeUp - Ultra Fast](https://modrinth.com/project/izsIPI7a). (version for 1.21.9 stills works fine in 1.21.10)

But shaders are **optional**, because they may **cause lag on weak PCs/Laptops** (Like me :))
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
# **⚠️ATTENTION⚠️**

## a/ Compatibility
1. This modpack just works for **Minecraft Fabric 1.21.10 only**!
2. **All devices will work** with this modpack, but **some devices may be sightly buggy, especially in old devices**.
3. This modpack is **not compatible with operating systems other Microsoft Windows**. That's mean **MacOS can't work** with this modpack.
4. Existing worlds **may not compatible** with this modpack.

## b/ ✨For the best experience, you must:✨

### 1/ 🗄️Download & install some mods/resource packs manually:
Four mods & one resource pack **can't be included in the modpack's dependencies due to licensing restrictions**. But you can download them manually.


<details>
<summary>🗃️Download & install these mods/resource packs manually🗃️ - PLEASE READ!</summary>

### **a. Mods**

1. [SmartTotem](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/smarttotem) (CurseForge)

### **b. Resource Packs**

### 2/ 🗃️Mod configs:
I'm sorry, but I **can't include the "config" folder in the modpack file**, but you can **download the pack by clicking [here](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1witiU3gO4S3tAJq9TUJH9zviS_batPsD)**.  Without it, you will lost many features, many FPS!

After downloading, **extract the pack**, read **Instructions.txt** to continue installing mod configs.

### 3/ 📁Resource Packs:
Resource packs are included in the modpack file, but after install, you need to sort them in Resource Pack options.
